title: Order Management
seo: eBay order management and tracking uploads
meta: Open eBay orders handled: shipping, tracking uploads and buyer updates, with a routine for new sales. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay order management, shipped on time and tracked
overview: Late tracking and slow replies hurt eBay seller ratings. We work through your open orders, buy labels in your eBay account when you ask, upload tracking so it shows to the buyer, and answer order questions. We also set up a handling routine with cut-off times, saved replies and a way to spot orders about to go late. This is a fixed sprint, and day-to-day handling afterward is quoted separately.

pkgs.blurb: Open orders reviewed and tracking uploaded.
More orders processed, with buyer messages answered.
A full order desk setup with templates and a hand-off guide.

faq: Yes, using your eBay account and your own payment method, once you give us account access. We never hold or move your money, and every label purchase can be seen in your account history.
What if an item goes missing in transit?
We check tracking, message the buyer with a clear update and guide you through the next step under eBay's rules. Refund decisions stay with you, and we never tell a buyer to cancel.
We prepare the cancellation steps and reasons for each case, since eBay counts seller-caused cancellations. If an order has to be cancelled, we do it only with your approval.
The number in your package: up to 60 in Standard and 150 in Premium. If you have more, we agree what to include first, and quote a monthly plan for steady handling.
